user.title: Ambient Color Sync
user.description: Lights follow the screen colours sent by EPC4Linux (Ambiglow Follow Video) or Hyperion.

data_description.lights: Colour lights that follow the screen. You can change them later in the options.

zones.title: Screen areas
zones.description: Choose the part of the screen each light follows.

create_entry.default:
In EPC4Linux (Ambiglow → Follow video), paste this webhook URL into the address field and tick **Send colours to Hubitat / Home Assistant (LAN)**:

`{url}`

Keep it private: whoever knows it can set your lights. The URL is also shown in this integration's options.

menu_options.behaviour: Brightness, pacing and end of stream

zones.title: Screen areas
zones.description: Choose the part of the screen each light follows.

behaviour.title: Brightness, pacing and end of stream

data_description.saturation_boost: Screen averages tend to grey; this makes the lights more colourful. 0 = the colours as on screen.
data_description.min_interval: Zigbee and Z-Wave bulbs: 1000 ms or more; Wi-Fi and LAN bulbs: 100-500 ms; WLED and other fast lights: 50 ms. A light that is still busy skips to the newest colour when it is ready.
data_description.change_threshold: A light is only updated when hue, saturation or brightness moved by this many points (0-100 scales).
data_description.transition: Fade time sent with each update (lights that do not support transitions ignore it).
data_description.on_off: "Respect": only lights that are on follow the screen; a light switched off by an automation, a rule or by hand stays off and follows again once it is switched on. The sync then never switches a light on or off itself (a black screen dims instead), except the "Turn the lights off" end action.
data_description.sensor_interval: Only the screen colour sensor, not the lights. Every change is stored by the recorder, so short intervals grow the database.

hyperion.title: Hyperion server
hyperion.description: Poll the LED colours of a Hyperion.ng server (JSON API, default port 19444). Not needed for EPC4Linux.

data.hyperion_token: API token (only if the server requires authorization)

options.restore: Restore the lights as they were

options.control: The sync switches lights on and off
options.respect: Respect on/off set elsewhere (only lights that are on follow)
